questions.text: In the text, what language term describes “old-fashioned”?
questions.passage: My oldest brother is quite different from me — he’s a bit old-fashioned really. I suppose he’s just very traditional. For example, he always wears a suit, a tie and leather shoes, listens to the radio and plays cricket. But the worst thing is that he’s got no sense of humour and that really gets on my nerves. I also get the impression that he thinks I’m pretty worthless, which doesn’t help our relationship. We rarely see each other these days. He sometimes calls in when he’s in the area and then we may go out together. But we usually end up arguing about which bus stop to walk to, or something silly like that.
